title: Work Symbols on Yardstick Tapes
statement: Let $s$ and $a$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and choose a clock phase, an input-head position, tape contents and head positions for the $s$ yardstick tapes, the $a$ attempt tapes, and the extra tape, together with an output word. For every yardstick-tape index $i$, the symbol read by the head at that index in the resulting host configuration is the content of yardstick tape $i$ at its chosen head position.
hypotheses_covered: Contents and head positions for all s yardstick tapes
Contents and head positions for all a attempt tapes
Contents and head position for the extra tape
